name: Fairfax County Teen Police Academy
what_you_do: Spend summer weekdays at police headquarters. You learn about patrol, crime scene investigations, use of force, SWAT and police vehicles. You explore law enforcement careers. You do it through hands-on activities.
who_can_apply: Fairfax County high school age students (public, private or home-schooled) entering grade 10, 11 or 12 in the 2026-2027 school year. Class size is limited.
pay_detail: Free. Transportation help is offered case by case.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026 class has graduated and to check back next year for 2027 session information. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Police Academy application on the page when the new session is posted. If you need a ride, email Captain Deanna Weand when you apply. Questions: 703-246-3332 or CPA@fairfaxcounty.gov.
notes: Classes are at Fairfax County Public Safety Headquarters, 12099 Government Center Parkway, Fairfax. Participants are expected to attend all classes. Not a job.
